text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual, referring to constitutional changes approved in referendum last month, says "institutions must comply with the nation's verdict".
- Draft finance law for 1997 to be discussed in the National Transitional Council.
- President Zeroual hints that reservations about the constitutional revision have become inappropriate.
- Islamist leader Mahfoud Nahnah says Hamas will not change its name.
- Public firms settle their debts in anachronistic way.
- Zeroual confirms determination to complete the building of a state of law with strong and democratic institutions.
- Bomb explosion in Paris subway kills two and injures 90.
- Child benefit to be included in the state's budget.
- Political parties voice position over developments in teachers' strike.
